metadata.case_name: GURUNG LACHHAMAN v. GURUNG CHANDRA PRAKASH T/A METRO CONSTRUCTION CO AND OTHERS

injuries.description: mild soft tissue contusion to his low back
source: I find that the injuries suffered by the Plaintiff in the Incident had caused mild soft tissue contusion to his low back and abrasion to his right knee.
injuries.icd_description: Contusion of lower back or pelvis

source: I find that the injuries suffered by the Plaintiff in the Incident had caused mild soft tissue contusion to his low back and abrasion to his right knee.
The knee injury was only a superficial abrasion wound which should be recovered well within a few weeks with no residual abnormality.

manifestations.description: Tenderness at para-spinal muscle at lower lumbar spine
Superficial skin abrasion at right knee
Numbness radiating down posterior aspect of his left thigh
Diminished ability in lifting heavy weights

losses.description: General damages for pain, suffering and loss of amenities for mild soft tissue contusion to low back and abrasion to right knee (PSLA awarded)
Pre-trial loss of earnings from 12 September 2005 to 28 November 2006 totalling $156,009.00

losses.category: Loss of ability to do domestic tasks
losses.description: Special damages for medical and related expenses totalling $8,425.00 (medical expenses, travelling, vitamin/food supplement)
